summary: Password-reset-link and server-address dialogs are modal on backdrop taps, use closed-loop keyboard traversal, support Escape cancellation and restore focus to the opener. Dialog-owned text controllers live until the route transition removes their fields, fixing use-after-dispose assertions during close.

checks.name: Auth dialog barrier, traversal and Escape regressions
checks.observation: Both new widget tests verify barrier taps leave the dialog open, routes use closed-loop traversal, Escape dismisses them, focus returns to the opener and the reverse transition completes without a disposed-controller exception.

checks.name: Authentication screen regression suite
checks.observation: All 12 auth screen widget tests passed, including layout, tabs, login validation and native error handling.

limitations: Physical keyboard and screen-reader acceptance was not performed on macOS, Windows or Android.
remaining: Verify native screen-reader announcements on macOS, Windows and Android; broader matched screenshots remain open.
